signers.description: List of 1 to 3 signatories of the DDA membership letter. Each signatory will receive an email with a link for digital signature.

name.description: Full name of the signatory as per identity document.

document_number.description: CPF of the signatory (format: 000.000.000-00 or numbers only).

email.description: Email of the signatory to send the digital signature link.

role.description: Position/role of the signatory in the company. Optional field. Values: `partner` (partner), `witness` (witness), `legal` (legal), `attorney` (attorney), `financial` (financial), `director` (director), `representative` (representative).

business_legal_name.description: Legal name of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. Optional field.

phone_number.description: Contact phone of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. Optional field.

address.description: Address of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. Optional field; all subfields are also optional. Replaces the entire previously saved hash — does not merge partially.

zip_code.description: CEP (format 99999999 — dashes and other non-numeric characters are automatically removed).

state.description: State abbreviation. Must be a valid Brazilian state.
